description: 臺南市污水下水道執行概況 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺南市政府水利局. 臺南市114年至100年用戶接管普及率及污水處理率開放資料V1. Coverage: 臺南市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺南市政府水利局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
